detail.longDescription: Pipedream Workflows is shutting down on March 31, 2027, along with String, Pipedream's AI agent builder. Pipedream will permanently delete all Workflows data by April 30, 2027. If you have workflows running there, you'll need to export them and rebuild them somewhere else before then. Here's how to export your Pipedream Workflows data and rebuild them as Zaps (Zapier's automated workflows) before the deadline.
